title: Elastic peel-away swipe list
blurb: Six live HTML inbox rows inside one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas with touch direction arbitration, 3D sticker-peel and elastic taffy shaders, reveal strips, and spring collapse with Undo.
question: Can I solve vertical-vs-horizontal touch arbitration on a scrollable inbox list while bending swiped live HTML rows on a GPU peel and elastic mesh that reveals Archive or Delete actions and smoothly spring-collapses remaining rows?
result: Built with one ElementGL WebGL 2 context, a 28 by 10 subdivided GPU mesh for 3D sticker peel and elastic taffy modes, angle-locked touch arbitration, updateElementGeometry() hit-box sync, a 2D 5-argument fallback and plain HTML context-loss recovery. Live browser runs on Chromium 157 and Chrome 159 for Android are not verified yet.
